versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֤ל הַשֵּׁנִי֙ לְשִׁמְע֔וֹן לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיְהִי֙ נַֽחֲלָתָ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
controles.kjv: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
controles.livre: A segunda porção saiu para Simeão, pela tribo dos filhos de Simeão conforme suas famílias; e sua herança foi entre a herança dos filhos de Judá.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּנַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם בְּאֵֽר־שֶׁ֥בַע וְשֶׁ֖בַע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃

controles.web: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
controles.kjv: And they had in their inheritance Beer–sheba, Sheba, and Moladah,
controles.livre: E tiveram em sua herdade a Berseba, Seba, e Moladá,

versos.hebraico: וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבָלָ֖ה וָעָֽצֶם׃

controles.web: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
controles.kjv: And Hazar–shual, and Balah, and Azem,
controles.livre: Hazar-Sual, Balá, e Azem,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּבְת֖וּל וְחָרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
controles.kjv: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
controles.livre: Eltolade, Betul, e Hormá,

versos.hebraico: וְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּבֵית־הַמַּרְכָּב֖וֹת וַחֲצַ֥ר סוּסָֽה׃

controles.web: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
controles.kjv: And Ziklag, and Beth–marcaboth, and Hazar–susah,
controles.livre: Ziclague, Bete-Marcabote, e Hazar-Susa,

versos.hebraico: וּבֵ֥ית לְבָא֖וֹת וְשָֽׁרוּחֶ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;
controles.kjv: And Beth–lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
controles.livre: Bete-Lebaote, e Saruém; treze cidades com suas aldeias:

versos.hebraico: עַ֥יִן׀ רִמּ֖וֹן וָעֶ֣תֶר וְעָשָׁ֑ן עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּ֖ע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;
controles.kjv: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
controles.livre: Aim, Rimom, Eter, e Asã; quatro cidades com suas aldeias:

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַֽחֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר סְבִיבוֹת֙ הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עַד־בַּֽעֲלַ֥ת בְּאֵ֖ר רָ֣אמַת נֶ֑גֶב זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
controles.kjv: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
controles.livre: E todas as aldeias que estavam ao redor destas cidades até Baalate-Beer, que é Ramá do sul. Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, segundo suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: מֵחֶ֨בֶל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחֲלַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־הָיָ֞ה חֵ֤לֶק בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָה֙ רַ֣ב מֵהֶ֔ם וַיִּנְחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֖וֹן בְּת֥וֹךְ נַחֲלָתָֽם׃פ

controles.web: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the midst of their inheritance.
controles.kjv: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
controles.livre: Da porção dos filhos de Judá foi tirada a herança dos filhos de Simeão; porquanto a parte dos filhos de Judá era escessiva para eles: assim que os filhos de Simeão tiveram sua herança em meio da deles.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַל֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִבְנֵ֥י זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל נַחֲלָתָ֖ם עַד־שָׂרִֽיד׃

controles.web: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.
controles.kjv: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
controles.livre: A terceira porção saiu pelos filhos de Zebulom conforme suas famílias: e o termo de sua herança foi até Saride.

versos.hebraico: וְעָלָ֨ה גְבוּלָ֧ם׀ לַיָּ֛מָּה וּמַרְעֲלָ֖ה וּפָגַ֣ע בְּדַבָּ֑שֶׁת וּפָגַע֙ אֶל־הַנַּ֔חַל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י יָקְנְעָֽם׃

controles.web: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
controles.kjv: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
controles.livre: E seu termo sobe até o mar e até Maralá, e chega até Dabesete, e dali chega ao ribeiro que está diante de Jocneão.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁ֣ב מִשָּׂרִ֗יד קֵ֚דְמָה מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ עַל־גְּב֥וּל כִּסְלֹ֖ת תָּבֹ֑ר וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־הַדָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְעָלָ֥ה יָפִֽיעַ׃

controles.web: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
controles.kjv: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth–tabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
controles.livre: E tornando de Saride até oriente, o oriente ao termo de Quislote-Tabor, sai a Daberate, e sobe a Jafia;

versos.hebraico: וּמִשָּׁ֤ם עָבַר֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה גִּתָּ֥ה חֵ֖פֶר עִתָּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְיָצָ֛א רִמּ֥וֹן הַמְּתֹאָ֖ר הַנֵּעָֽה׃

controles.web: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
controles.kjv: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah–hepher, to Ittah–kazin, and goeth out to Remmon–methoar to Neah;
controles.livre: E passando dali até o lado oriental a Gate-Hefer e a Ete-Cazim, sai a Rimom rodeando a Neá;

versos.hebraico: וְנָסַ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ הַגְּב֔וּל מִצְּפ֖וֹן חַנָּתֹ֑ן וְהָיוּ֙ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו גֵּ֖י יִפְתַּח־אֵֽל׃

controles.web: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
controles.kjv: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah–el:
controles.livre: E daqui torna este termo ao norte a Hanatom, vindo a sair ao vale de Iftá-El;

versos.hebraico: וְקַטָּ֤ת וְנַֽהֲלָל֙ וְשִׁמְר֔וֹן וְיִדְאֲלָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית לָ֑חֶם עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth–lehem: twelve cities with their villages.
controles.livre: E engloba Catate, e Naalal, e Sinrom, e Idala, e Belém; doze cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם הֶֽעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

controles.web: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
controles.livre: Esta é a herdade dos filhos de Zebulom por suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הָֽרְבִיעִ֑י לִבְנֵ֥י יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.
controles.kjv: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
controles.livre: A quarta porção saiu para Issacar, pelos filhos de Issacar conforme suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אלָה וְהַכְּסוּלֹ֖ת וְשׁוּנֵֽם׃

controles.web: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
controles.kjv: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
controles.livre: E foi seu termo Jezreel, e Quesulote, e Suném,

versos.hebraico: וַחֲפָרַ֥יִם וְשִׁיאֹ֖ן וַאֲנָחֲרַֽת׃

controles.web: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
controles.kjv: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,
controles.livre: E Hafaraim, e Siom, e Anaarate,

versos.hebraico: וְהָֽרַבִּ֥ית וְקִשְׁי֖וֹן וָאָֽבֶץ׃

controles.web: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
controles.kjv: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
controles.livre: E Rabite, e Quisiom, e Ebes,

versos.hebraico: וְרֶ֧מֶת וְעֵין־גַּנִּ֛ים וְעֵ֥ין חַדָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית פַּצֵּֽץ׃

controles.web: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
controles.kjv: And Remeth, and En–gannim, and En–haddah, and Beth–pazzez;
controles.livre: E Remete, e En-Ganim, e En-Hadá e Bete-Pazez;

versos.hebraico: וּפָגַע֩ הַגְּב֨וּל בְּתָב֤וֹר ושחצומה וּבֵ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת גְּבוּלָ֖ם הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth–shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
controles.livre: E chega este termo até Tabor, e Saazima, e Bete-Semes; e sai seu termo ao Jordão: dezesseis cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

controles.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
controles.livre: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Issacar conforme suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַֽחֲמִישִׁ֔י לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־אָשֵׁ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
controles.kjv: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
controles.livre: E saiu a quinta porção pela tribo dos filhos de Aser por suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑ם חֶלְקַ֥ת וַחֲלִ֖י וָבֶ֥טֶן וְאַכְשָֽׁף׃

controles.web: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
controles.kjv: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
controles.livre: E seu termo foi Helcate, e Hali, e Béten, e Acsafe,

versos.hebraico: וְאַֽלַמֶּ֥לֶךְ וְעַמְעָ֖ד וּמִשְׁאָ֑ל וּפָגַ֤ע בְּכַרְמֶל֙ הַיָּ֔מָּה וּבְשִׁיח֖וֹר לִבְנָֽת׃

controles.web: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
controles.kjv: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor–libnath;
controles.livre: E Alameleque, e Amade, e Misal; e chega até Carmelo ao ocidente, e a Sior-Libnate;

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁ֨ב מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ֮ בֵּ֣ית דָּגֹן֒ וּפָגַ֣ע בִּ֠זְבֻלוּן וּבְגֵ֨י יִפְתַּח־אֵ֥ל צָפ֛וֹנָה בֵּ֥ית הָעֵ֖מֶק וּנְעִיאֵ֑ל וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־כָּב֖וּל מִשְּׂמֹֽאל׃

controles.web: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
controles.kjv: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
controles.livre: E tornando do oriente a Bete-Dagom, chega a Zebulom, e ao vale de Iftá-El ao norte, a Bete-Emeque, e a Neiel, e sai a Cabul à esquerda;

versos.hebraico: וְעֶבְרֹ֥ן וּרְחֹ֖ב וְחַמּ֣וֹן וְקָנָ֑ה עַ֖ד צִיד֥וֹן רַבָּֽה׃

controles.web: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
controles.kjv: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
controles.livre: E engloba a Hebrom, e Reobe, e Hamom, e Caná, até a grande Sidom;

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁ֤ב הַגְּבוּל֙ הָֽרָמָ֔ה וְעַד־עִ֖יר מִבְצַר־צֹ֑ר וְשָׁ֤ב הַגְּבוּל֙ חֹסָ֔ה ויהיו תֹצְאֹתָ֛יו הַיָּ֖מָּה מֵחֶ֥בֶל אַכְזִֽיבָה׃

controles.web: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
controles.kjv: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
controles.livre: E torna dali este termo a Hormá, e até a forte cidade de Tiro, e torna este termo a Hosa, e sai ao mar desde o território de Aczibe:

versos.hebraico: וְעֻמָ֥ה וַאֲפֵ֖ק וּרְחֹ֑ב עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
controles.livre: Engloba também Umá, e Afeque, e Reobe: vinte e duas cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־אָשֵׁ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

controles.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
controles.livre: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Aser por suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֑י לִבְנֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
controles.kjv: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
controles.livre: A sexta porção saiu para os filhos de Naftali, pelos filhos de Naftali conforme suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מֵחֵ֨לֶף מֵֽאֵל֜וֹן בְּצַעֲנַנִּ֗ים וַאֲדָמִ֥י הַנֶּ֛קֶב וְיַבְנְאֵ֖ל עַד־לַקּ֑וּם וַיְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

controles.web: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adaminekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
controles.kjv: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
controles.livre: E foi seu termo desde Helefe, e Alom-Zaanim, e Adami-Neguebe, e Jabneel, até Lacum; e sai ao Jordão;

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁ֨ב הַגְּב֥וּל יָ֨מָּה֙ אַזְנ֣וֹת תָּב֔וֹר וְיָצָ֥א מִשָּׁ֖ם חוּקֹ֑קָה וּפָגַ֨ע בִּזְבֻל֜וּן מִנֶּ֗גֶב וּבְאָשֵׁר֙ פָּגַ֣ע מִיָּ֔ם וּבִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

controles.web: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.
controles.kjv: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth–tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
controles.livre: E tornando dali este termo até o ocidente a Aznote-Tabor, passa dali a Hucoque, e chega até Zebulom ao sul, e ao ocidente confina com Aser, e com Judá ao Jordão até o oriente.

versos.hebraico: וְעָרֵ֖י מִבְצָ֑ר הַצִּדִּ֣ים צֵ֔ר וְחַמַּ֖ת רַקַּ֥ת וְכִנָּֽרֶת׃

controles.web: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
controles.kjv: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
controles.livre: E as cidades fortes são Zidim, Zer, e Hamate, Racate, e Quinerete,

versos.hebraico: וַאֲדָמָ֥ה וְהָרָמָ֖ה וְחָצֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
controles.kjv: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
controles.livre: E Adama, e Ramá, e Hazor,

versos.hebraico: וְקֶ֥דֶשׁ וְאֶדְרֶ֖עִי וְעֵ֥ין חָצֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
controles.kjv: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En–hazor,
controles.livre: E Quedes, e Edrei, e En-Hazor,

versos.hebraico: וְיִרְאוֹן֙ וּמִגְדַּל־אֵ֔ל חֳרֵ֥ם וּבֵית־עֲנָ֖ת וּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ עָרִ֥ים תְּשַֽׁע־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Iron, and Migdal–el, Horem, and Beth–anath, and Beth–shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
controles.livre: E Irom, e Migdal-Ele, e Horém, e Bete-Anate, e Bete-Semes: dezenove cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

controles.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
controles.livre: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Naftali por suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־דָ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֥ל הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃

controles.web: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
controles.kjv: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
controles.livre: A sétima porção saiu para a tribo dos filhos de Dã por suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֖י גְּב֣וּל נַחֲלָתָ֑ם צָרְעָ֥ה וְאֶשְׁתָּא֖וֹל וְעִ֥יר שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃

controles.web: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,
controles.kjv: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir–shemesh,
controles.livre: E foi o termo de sua herança, Zorá, e Estaol, e Ir-Semes,

versos.hebraico: וְשַֽׁעֲלַבִּ֥ין וְאַיָּל֖וֹן וְיִתְלָֽה׃

controles.web: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
controles.kjv: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
controles.livre: E Saalabim, e Aijalom, e Itla,

versos.hebraico: וְאֵיל֥וֹן וְתִמְנָ֖תָה וְעֶקְרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
controles.kjv: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
controles.livre: E Elom, e Timna, e Ecrom,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶלְתְּקֵ֥ה וְגִבְּת֖וֹן וּבַעֲלָֽת׃

controles.web: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
controles.kjv: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
controles.livre: E Elteque, Gibetom, e Baalate,

versos.hebraico: וִיהֻ֥ד וּבְנֵֽי־בְרַ֖ק וְגַת־רִמּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
controles.kjv: And Jehud, and Bene–berak, and Gath–rimmon,
controles.livre: E Jeúde, e Bene-Beraque, e Gate-Rimom,

versos.hebraico: וּמֵ֥י הַיַּרְק֖וֹן וְהָֽרַקּ֑וֹן עִֽם־הַגְּב֖וּל מ֥וּל יָפֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border over against Joppa.
controles.kjv: And Me–jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
controles.livre: E Me-Jarcom, e Racom, com o termo que está diante de Jope.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֥א גְבוּל־בְּנֵי־דָ֖ן מֵהֶ֑ם וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בְנֵֽי־דָ֠ן וַיִּלָּחֲמ֨וּ עִם־לֶ֜שֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּד֥וּ אוֹתָ֣הּ׀ וַיַּכּ֧וּ אוֹתָ֣הּ לְפִי־חֶ֗רֶב וַיִּֽרְשׁ֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ לְלֶ֨שֶׁם֙ דָּ֔ן כְּשֵׁ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
controles.kjv: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
controles.livre: E faltou-lhes termo aos filhos de Dã; e subiram os filhos de Dã e combateram a Lesém, e tomando-a feriram-na a fio de espada, e a possuíram, e habitaram nela; e chamaram a Lesém, Dã, do nome de Dã seu pai.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־דָ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶֽעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

controles.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
controles.livre: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Dã conforme suas famílias; estas cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַלּ֥וּ לִנְחֹל־אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל נַחֲלָ֛ה לִיהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־נ֖וּן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

controles.web: So they made an end of distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun in their midst.
controles.kjv: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
controles.livre: E depois que acabaram de repartir a terra em herança por seus termos, deram os filhos de Israel herança a Josué filho de Num em meio deles:

versos.hebraico: עַל־פִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה נָ֣תְנוּ ל֗וֹ אֶת־הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶת־תִּמְנַת־סֶ֖רַח בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיִּבְנֶ֥ה אֶת־הָעִ֖יר וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: According to the commandment of Yahweh, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.
controles.kjv: According to the word of the Lord they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath–serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
controles.livre: Segundo a palavra do SENHOR, lhe deram a cidade que ele pediu, Timnate-Heres, no monte de Efraim; e ele reedificou a cidade, e habitou nela.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה הַנְּחָלֹ֡ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִחֲל֣וּ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֣ן׀ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֪עַ בִּן־נ֟וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֣וֹת לְמַטּוֹת֩ בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל׀ בְּגוֹרָ֤ל׀ בְּשִׁלֹה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיְכַלּ֕וּ מֵֽחַלֵּ֖ק אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

controles.web: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they made an end of dividing the land.
controles.kjv: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
controles.livre: Estas são as propriedades que Eleazar sacerdote, e Josué filho de Num, e os principais dos pais, entregaram por sorte em possessão às tribos dos filhos de Israel em Siló diante do SENHOR, à entrada do tabernáculo do testemunho; e acabaram de repartir a terra.
